three_judgments.path: FAILS the bar. Build: if agent-attach re-rates APPN as a quality AI-software name + low-teens compounding, EV/S ~1.9x→~5-6x over 2-4yr ⇒ ~2-3x — short of 4x. Discriminators SHOWN vs asserted: (1) backlog converting = PARTIAL — real firm cloud-ARR conversion BUT net-new ACV flat YoY (82% of bookings 'consistent with prior year', not accelerating) & growth DECELERATING multi-year (total rev 17%FY23→13%FY24→15-16%FY25→13-14%FY26 guide; cloud 29%→21%→18-19%→18-19%); (2) on-date milestone = N/A (no dated catalyst, continuous adoption); (3) firm Tier-1 cash contract = N/A; (4) margin/CF inflection to GAAP+ = SHOWS (adj-EBITDA $26.6M Q1, FY26 $97-105M, OCF $48.8M Q1, EPS guide +~60%) — but this underwrites a RE-RATE, not a ≥4x growth path. The 115% net-ARR expansion (only 112→114→115 QoQ) is driven by 25% AI-tier PRICE uplift + upmarket upsell on the INSTALLED base (CFO), i.e. the mixed-fuel re-rate half — confirmed not refuted. ~1.5/4 discriminators; ≥4x needs a heroic multiple-triple on a decelerating low-teens grower (public since 2017, de-rated $235→$25 BECAUSE growth slowed). Neither credible ≥4x (multibagger) NOR high-confidence PROTECTED 3-4x with a DEFINED catalyst (great trade) → DROP. Strong proxy for the theme, but vehicle geometry caps below the bar.
three_judgments.asymmetry: Adequate but not dominating, and ceiling below bar. Bull ~2-3x (~$50-70: durable margin inflection + re-rate to 4-5x sales + low-teens compound). Base ~flat-to-+30% (~$25-32: stays ~14% grower, EV/S 2-3x). Bear ~-35-45% (~$14-16: attach=one-quarter pipeline pop, growth fades, multiple compresses to ~1.3x sales trough — saw $18.63 this yr). Rough U/D ~2-3x up / ~0.4x down — fine for a hold but the upside CEILING sits below 4x and below a protected 3-4x; not the dominating asymmetry a scarce deep-dive slot demands.
three_judgments.survival: Pristine — NO impairment risk. ~$206M cash, no debt, positive & growing adj-EBITDA + OCF, $100M buyback (doubled). Not ruin, not pre-profit. The one prong it passes easily; but survival can't rescue a path that caps below the bar.

strongest_bear: A 15-yr-old ex-high-flyer low-teens grower the market ALREADY de-rated $235→$25 precisely because growth structurally slowed to the teens. The 'agentic re-rate' is largely 25% AI-tier price uplift + upmarket upsell on the installed base dressed as an inflection — net-new logo bookings flat YoY. Enterprise low-code/process-automation has low switching costs + intensifying competition (Salesforce Agentforce, ServiceNow Now Assist, Microsoft Copilot bolting agents onto far larger installed bases). Credible outcome = a quality ~14% grower that re-rates to a quality multiple (~2-3x over years), not a ≥4x and not a protected catalyst-defined 3-4x.
best_vehicle: APPN itself (the one clean on-list converter; off-list pure-plays PEGA/PATH are stronger horizontal expressions but benchmark-only, no flag) — but as a DROP the theme waits in the Tier-0 map (HUNT/P2) for a better-shaped on-list vehicle or an APPN re-acceleration.
drop_reason: thin-setup-not-worth-a-slot — strong theme proxy but vehicle geometry caps below the bar: a multi-year-decelerating low-teens grower (13-14% total / 18-19% cloud) can't credibly ≥4x without a heroic multiple-triple, and the 'inflection' is mostly price-uplift/upmarket-upsell on the installed base (net-new ACV flat YoY, no dated catalyst) so it's not a high-confidence protected 3-4x great trade either. Survival pristine but irrelevant. Theme stays live in Tier-0 map; APPN doesn't earn a scarce Tier-3 slot.
